Program architecture

One journey. Three connected phases.

The supplied 30-day curriculum becomes the foundation for a longer 3-month learning and internship experience.

PHASE 01 · DAYS 1-30

AI + Generative AI Training

AI/ML foundations, deep learning, transformers, LLMs, prompting, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, fine-tuning, agents, responsible AI and security.

PHASE 02 · WEEKS 5-8

Hands-On Build Lab

Turn concepts into working prototypes through guided exercises, model playgrounds, RAG workflows, tool-using agents and practical problem solving.

PHASE 03 · WEEKS 9-12

Internship + Project Experience

Work through an internship-style project cycle with tasks, reviews, documentation, demonstrations and a final presentation.

CAREER TRACK

Job Assistance

Resume guidance, portfolio positioning, interview preparation and career assistance. Placement support is provided where applicable; outcomes are not guaranteed.

30-day core curriculum

From AI foundations to autonomous AI concepts.

The attached plan is a 1-hour-per-day, 30-day progression. The original sequence and terminology are retained here.

WEEK 01 · DAYS 1-7

AI & ML Foundations

  • AI, ML and Deep Learning
  • Learning paradigms
  • Neural networks
  • RNNs and Transformers
  • Generative vs discriminative models
  • Recap, quiz and case discussion
WEEK 02 · DAYS 8-14

GenAI & LLM Fundamentals

  • LLMs, tokens, embeddings and context
  • Pretraining, fine-tuning and RLHF
  • Model families and selection
  • Multimodal AI
  • Hallucinations and limitations
  • Model playground lab
WEEK 03 · DAYS 15-21

Prompt Engineering & RAG

  • Prompt anatomy and techniques
  • System vs user prompts
  • Prompt iteration lab
  • Why RAG exists
  • Embeddings and vector databases
  • End-to-end RAG architecture
WEEK 04 · DAYS 22-28

Fine-Tuning + Agent Engineering

  • Prompting vs RAG vs fine-tuning
  • PEFT, LoRA and adapters
  • Agents, planning and tool calling
  • Memory and context engineering
  • Evaluation and reliability
  • Responsible AI and security
DAYS 29-30

Advanced Agents + Capstone

  • Multi-agent systems
  • Graph engineering
  • Experience memory
  • Self-evolving agents
  • Long-running autonomous agents
  • Capstone presentation
BY THE END

What you can demonstrate

  • Practical GenAI prototype
  • Prompt design and evaluation
  • RAG and semantic retrieval
  • Basic tool-using AI agent
  • Security and reliability thinking
  • End-to-end agent architecture
Hands-on learningGuided exercises, discussions, model playgrounds, case studies and practical labs.
CapstoneIndividual or team-based practical AI/Generative AI prototype with presentation and feedback.
Agent engineeringContext, memory, tools, workflows, harnesses, loops, evaluation and reliability.
Production mindsetResponsible AI, privacy, prompt injection, access control, observability and control.
Internship phase

Learn first. Then experience the work.

The internship component is free. It is designed to give learners a structured environment to apply what they learn through projects and practical tasks.

FREE INTERNSHIP

60-day project & internship experience

After the core training, selected participants can move into the internship/project phase, subject to program process and availability.

✓Practical project assignments
✓Mentor-led reviews and feedback

RAG Knowledge Assistant

Design a grounded question-answering workflow using document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval and generation.

Tool-Using AI Agent

Build an agent that can call a basic tool or internal API and demonstrate controlled execution.

AI Career Assistant

Create a practical AI workflow for career guidance, resume analysis or structured job-preparation support.

GenAI Business Automation

Identify a repetitive business process and prototype an AI-assisted workflow with evaluation and guardrails.

Internship participation is free, but eligibility, selection, project allocation and continuation may be subject to program requirements. Internship and placement support should not be interpreted as a guaranteed job offer.
